method: Successor ingestion into a new store from the frozen C4 corpus; raw store inspection; current-authority query; fresh-store repetition; cancellation before session.

repetition.conclusion: Repeated reconstruction is logically deterministic; physical container bytes are not claimed stable.

lossLimits.reconstructibleWithAuthoritativeInputs: graph and occurrence facts within the available source/reference scope
notReconstructibleWithoutInputs: reference images not available or not byte-identical
historical publication/run metadata not present in the source scope

adjudication: Reconstruction into a new store is supported for the frozen corpus and preserves contributor ownership, target identity, durability and repeated logical identity. No automatic destructive rebuild or in-place migration exists. The strategy is not universally lossless.
